# mini-scales U177 printed appearance

Weighing-platform MAX5KG label, rear RGB/BTN/ADC/controller/protocol diagram and actual Grove-end blue-arrow label.

Included as high-resolution reference-redrawn PNGs. The artwork contains freshly drawn text/shapes and no product photograph pixels or crops. Exact source URLs/image hashes, final raster hashes, sizes, support parts and registrations are in `artwork.json`. Raw reference photos, private lookup, generators and intermediates are excluded from the repository. M5Stack marks and original designs retain their respective rights; these are reference reconstructions rather than production artwork.

- front: [https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-d8315796-ac9f-413f-98ee-b9f7ea74eaf3.webp](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-d8315796-ac9f-413f-98ee-b9f7ea74eaf3.webp); SHA-256 `b37cb12eb214b5b2921b8bfa0a3833b0660114a9bdfc831480c097f2edcf5bc4`.
- back: [https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-7291873c-48bf-413f-a218-156c069e2141.webp](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-7291873c-48bf-413f-a218-156c069e2141.webp); SHA-256 `549b3ded2d337ee8833e150660e7a7eb321e5d9e8ed3468591f774c3e05ae3f7`.
- end-arrow: [https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-b9cc6e44-bd3c-4256-bd72-5fb45423483c.webp](https://static-cdn.m5stack.com/resource/docs/products/unit/Unit-Mini%20Scales/img-b9cc6e44-bd3c-4256-bd72-5fb45423483c.webp); SHA-256 `5b29c0cdd67719164896225d4261425e86ddac9a028e9ba0ddb717234eac90e6`.

Surface coverage and registration:

- front: printedFilm on `Mini Scales native weighing platform`, [10.2, 18.2] mm, center [0, -3.6, 8.812] mm. Continuous MAX5KG label spans existing native platform service openings.
- back: printedFilm on `Mini Scales native lower housing`, [21.2, 29.5] mm, center [0, 1.75, -8.812] mm. Continuous T-shaped label has transparent die-cut exterior and spans the native short-neck recess.
- bottom/end: printedArtwork on `Mini Scales native weighing platform`, [6.2, 3.2] mm, center [0, -19.72, 5.6] mm. Only existing outward-facing support triangles are printed; ports and bores stay open.

All panels use `artworkKind: reference-redraw`. `artwork:false` disables every printed panel. No originally unprinted cap, lever, slider grip or button is given fictional ink; all registered graphics belong to their actual fixed shell/platform/terminal support. Actual continuous adhesive films retain the original native openings underneath, independently of the existing physical PCB/mechanism assemblies.

`sticker-smoke.json` confirms finite/nonempty registered geometry, exact before-change physical vertex/normal/index/material/world-transform signatures, unchanged original component state/API and driven motion, terminal-plug variants where applicable, and Grove four-wire attach/pose/detach. The original source geometry, controls and connectors are unchanged. Colours, typography and layout are reconstructed from photographs and fitted to native label recesses, not production-print data. Browser pixel inspection remains deferred; stage stays modeled. No other readable printed face is currently identified in these exact references; molded marks and unreadable manufacturing stamps are not redrawn.
